caption: The drawing depicts a wall-mounted metal structure, which consists of a bracket with a large decorative spiral design. Attached to the spiral bracket is a circular, flat platform with a rim and some depth, shown in multiple shades of gray to indicate a metallic or monochrome appearance. Hanging from the underside of the platform are four similarly-shaped, rectangular, hollow objects, each suspended by a short length of chain. The rectangular objects are shaded to show three-dimensional form and likely represent bells or scoops. At the very center beneath the platform is a small, ornate metallic fixture. The entire composition is rendered in grayscale tones with a beige or off-white background, and there is a handwritten note in the top right corner and a signature with a date at the bottom right.
title: Colonial Chimes
